policies.title: Honduran ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's currently linked official nationality schedule lists Honduras as requiring a visa prior to arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Honduran passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Grenada's schedule defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained at a Grenada mission or consulate before travel.
The schedule is actively linked but was updated April 2024; recheck if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, study, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service, special-document and final-admission treatment remain outside scope.

policies.title: Honduran ordinary passports: Panama visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule expressly includes Honduras in the no-visa visitor cohort for stays up to three months.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Honduran passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The named no-visa cohort states a maximum tourist stay of three months.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Honduran ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's live Tourism Board nationality table states that Honduran visitors can obtain a 40-JOD visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Honduran passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The Tourism Board table says all non-Jordanians must register for a Gateway2Jordan QR code before departure.
Entry-point, admission and non-visitor categories remain governed by Jordanian authorities.
